description: This file defines a serializable class 'ProductList' that encapsulates a list of 'ReadableProduct' objects and their count, serving as a data transfer object in the project.

classes.name: ProductList
classes.description: Encapsulates a list of products and the total product count, implements Serializable for data transfer.

methods.name: setProducts
methods.description: Sets the list of ReadableProduct objects.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of ReadableProduct objects.

methods.name: getProductCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of products.

methods.name: setProductCount
methods.description: Sets the total number of products.
